name: Morning Routine
description: Start the day with intention — energizing wake-up sequence, routine walkthrough, and motivational closer. Best for productivity and wellness content.
voice_style: upbeat, breathy energy, warm — think 'wellness coach meets morning radio host'
music_mood: lo-fi hip hop, morning acoustic, positive ambient

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: The 5am morning routine that changed everything about my productivity.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Sunrise time-lapse through bedroom blinds, alarm clock 5:00am, cozy bedroom with warm light spilling in
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow push-in from wide bedroom shot to bedside alarm clock detail
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm golden hour natural light streaming through blinds, shallow depth of field, lens flare on edges
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Use soft warm tones, bokeh background, emphasize light rays through blinds for cinematic feel

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Step one: No phone for the first 20 minutes. I do this before I touch my phone — journal, hydrate, and 10 deep breaths.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: POV hands reaching for bedside water bottle, notebook open, morning light on face, close-up of pen writing
scene_sequence.camera_movement: POV tracking shot, slight tilt down as hands move toward notebook, macro close-up on pen writing
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: natural softbox from window, side lighting on face, cool blue morning tones with warm desk lamp accent
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Emphasize tactile detail — water droplets, paper texture, pen tip. Maintain shallow DOF for intimate morning feel

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Step two: Cold plunge or cold shower — 90 seconds. It activates cortisol, sharpens focus, and makes everything else feel easy by comparison.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Bathroom shower POV, water splashing, person stepping out looking refreshed, close-up of face with eyes open
scene_sequence.camera_movement: POV handheld shake simulation for shower, static close-up for face reaction, subtle push-in on refreshed expression
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: bathroom fluorescent mixed with window light, slight blue-green tint from water, steam visible in light beams
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Mist/steam atmosphere adds cinematic texture; sharp face close-up with skin glow from cold water

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Step three: Movement — 15 minutes of yoga or a 20-minute walk outside. Sunlight on your face resets your circadian rhythm.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person in living room doing yoga stretches, outdoor shot of person walking in morning fog, sunlight through trees
scene_sequence.camera_movement: wide establishing shot, slow tracking pan following yoga flow, pull-out to aerial-style wide for outdoor scene
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: outdoor: backlit golden hour sun through morning fog, lens flare; indoor: soft neutral ambient with single key light from window
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Combine indoor yoga sequence with outdoor walk; backlit rim lighting creates professional cinematic quality

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Step four: The power hour — hardest task first. No meetings, no Slack. Just you and your most important work for 60 minutes straight.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Clean desk setup, laptop screen glowing, hands typing, cup of coffee, focused face close-up
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow cinematic push-in from overhead desk wide shot to face close-up, subtle pan across desk items
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm desk lamp as key light, laptop screen as fill/rim light, deep shadows for cinematic mood, blue-light glow on face
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Dark moody workspace aesthetic — screen light illuminating face from below creates compelling cinematic portrait

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Do this for 30 days and watch your output transform. Save this, screenshot it, do it. Your future self will thank you.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Montage of the full routine, person smiling confidently, text overlay '30 days from now...', sunrise closing shot
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow montage cross-cuts between routine moments, final pull-back to wide sunrise closing shot
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm triumphant golden light throughout, sunrise warm orange tones, final shot backlit with sun in frame
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Montage rhythm; sunrise final shot should be iconic — lens flare, backlit silhouette, warm color grade throughout
